$comment: Authored inputs of build.mjs. category = Arabic style in the vocabulary of font.schema.json, judged from the upstream description and the design; interfaceText = whether the family is a candidate for interface text (false: display, calligraphic or colour faces, catalogued and measured but not compared). latinCompanion is recorded only where the upstream description or repository states it.

alexandria.latinCompanion: Montserrat (upstream: designed as the Arabic companion of Montserrat; Latin included)

alyamama.latinCompanion: UNAL Ancizar (upstream: Latin glyphs based on it; included)

aref-ruqaa.latinCompanion: AMS Euler (upstream: Latin part based on it; included)

baloo-bhaijaan-2.latinCompanion: Baloo 2 Latin (upstream: each Baloo family carries the shared Latin; included)

cairo.latinCompanion: Titillium Web (upstream: Cairo extends it to Arabic; Latin included)

el-messiri.latinCompanion: Philosopher (upstream: the family began with this Latin and Cyrillic typeface; included)

mada.latinCompanion: Source Sans Pro (upstream: Latin is a slightly modified version; included)

readex-pro.latinCompanion: Lexend (upstream: Readex Pro applies the Lexend method to Arabic; Latin included)

excludeFromBounds.Tajawal-ExtraBold.ttf: font defect: kasratan (uni064D) on the lam-alef ligatures attaches about 950 units too low (its mark anchor is y=895 in the below-mark class), giving a bottom of -1532

vazirmatn.latinCompanion: Roboto (upstream: combined with Roboto for the Latin glyph set; included)

kawkab-mono.licenseEvidence: OFL.txt in the repository and in the release zip
kawkab-mono.latinCompanion: Source Code Pro (upstream release notes: paired with it since v0.500; included)
kawkab-mono.notes: Last release 2016 (v0.501). Not on npm under @fontsource or kawkab-mono (HTTP 404 on 2026-11-11).

vazir-code.licenseEvidence: LICENSE in the repository: changes by the author are public domain, fonts are (c) Bitstream under the Bitstream Vera license. The README says the Latin comes from Inconsolata (OFL-1.1) and Hack; the LICENSE file does not mention them. Not OFL; review before shipping.
vazir-code.notes: Upstream README states the project is archived and no longer developed. Single weight.
